name: Abby Taylor
bio: Abby has spent 30 years in food and beverage, starting as a counter attendant at a New England clam shack at 15, and has brought that same enthusiasm to neighborhood favorites and Michelin-starred kitchens alike. As Urban Hearth's General Manager since 2022, she has been a steady hand through the restaurant's first James Beard nomination, its first Michelin recommendation, its Best of Boston awards, and its move to Inman Square. She is devoted to providing a supportive, sustainable work environment for our team and remarkable hospitality for our guests.

name: Katie Janik
bio: Katie joined Urban Hearth in 2023 after a long career in hospitality that she pursued, impressively, while putting herself through law school. Her professionalism and composure are a constant on the floor, and her love of wine is something guests get to benefit from directly. When she's not here, she's working through a stack of books or drinking iced coffee, even in January.

name: Rebecca Daulton
bio: Originally from Columbus, Ohio, Rebecca left a career in accounting to pursue what she actually loved: food. She joined Urban Hearth in 2022 as a kitchen intern while studying classical French and Italian cuisine at the Cambridge School of Culinary Arts, graduating as valedictorian in 2023. She considers it the start of a lifelong culinary education. On the line she delights in vegetables and the endlessly rewarding study of dough, both sweet and savory.
